Appendix B - Scriptable Text Editor Dictionary

About Text Objects

The Scriptable Text Editor deals mainly with text; therefore, most of its objects are text objects. The Scriptable Text Editor defines five text object classes:
  • Character
  • Word
  • Paragraph
  • Text
  • Text Item
The following sections describe characteristics that these objects have in common. To avoid ambiguity, objects that belong to the class Text are always referred to as "objects of class Text." Objects that belong to the character,
word, paragraph, text, or text item classes are called "text objects."
